children: Shares of Pine Labs gained in early trade on Tuesday, September 22, after 4.97 crore of its shares or 4.3% of tis equity changed hands in block deals
The official buyers and sellers are not yet known.
reported, citing sources that Mastercard Asia was likely to sell 4.97 crore shares, or 4.3% stake, in the company via a block deal.
The floor price had been set at ₹179.5 per share and the holder sought to raise ₹892.5 crore, the sources added.

As per data available on the exchanges, public shareholders hold 100% stake in Pine Labs. Of this, Mastercard Asia/Pacific Pte Ltd held 4.31% stake or 4.97 crore equity shares in the company, at the end of the June quarter.
Pine Labs shares listed on the stock exchanges on November 14, 2025.

As per its red herring prospectus (RHP), available on the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), Mastercard Asia/Pacific Pte Ltd was an investor selling shareholder in the offer for sale (OFS). It was looking at selling up to 59.25 lakh equity shares of face value ₹1 with the weighted average cost of acquisition per equity share of ₹128.62, the RHP stated.
Earlier this month, Pine Labs witnessed another large trade, where 3.5 crore shares or 3.1% of its equity worth ₹550 crore in a block deal window.
Later it was revealed that Alpha Wave Ventures had sold the 3.55 crore shares or 3.1% equity in the compay worth ₹550 crore via block deal.

ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company had bought 1.03 crore shares or 0.89% equity in the company for ₹160 crore, Societe Generate bought 45.3 lakh shares or 0.39% equity for ₹70.3 crore, Goldman Sachs Investment Mauritius bought 41.6 lakh shares or 0.36% equity for ₹64.5 crore shares and Vindian Asia Opportunities Master Fund bought 41.3 lakh shares or 0.36% equity for ₹64.1 crore.
The deal was executed at an average price of ₹155.1 per share on the National Stock Exchamge.
Shares of Pine Labs were up 0.8% in early trade at ₹195.25 apiece on Tuesday. The stock has risen 22.3% in the past month but has declined 18.1% this year, so far.
The stock is down 12.8% from its issue price of ₹221 per share and has fallen 20.4% from its listing price of ₹242 apiece.

title: Pine Labs shares worth ₹934 crore change hands in a block deal; Mastercard Asia likely seller
